Би СЭЗИС-д мэдээллийн системийн менежмен: I’m a fourth-year Information Systems Management student at the University of Finance and Economics. Working with HR records and building a CV registration app during my internship showed me how well-organized information makes everyday tasks easier.
Хичээлээс гадуур White Hats клубийн гишү: I’m a member of the White Hats and Cups clubs. In my free time, I play basketball and practise traditional Mongolian archery.
Projects компонентын inside төлөв картын: Each project card switches from its cover to a walkthrough. You can explore one step at a time. Selecting a step updates just that card.
Бүтээлүүдийн мэдээлэл хаанаас ирдэг вэ?: Where does the project information come from?
useProjects эхлээд хамт ирсэн нийтэд нээ: The useProjects hook first displays the bundled project list, then requests published projects from Supabase in display order. The bundled list stays available if the connection drops.
PostgreSQL дээр зочинд зөвхөн SELECT эрх: PostgreSQL grants guests read access through SELECT. Row Level Security returns only published rows. The browser connects with the public publishable key.
Гар утас болон гарын товчоор хэрхэн ашиг: How do I navigate on mobile or with a keyboard?
720 пиксел болон түүнээс бага өргөнд кар: At 720 pixels or narrower, cards stack in one column and the navigation moves into a menu. Use Tab to move between controls and Escape to close a menu or project dialog. The name animation respects your reduced-motion preference.

Өгөгдөлд дүн шинжилгээ хийж, үр дүнг нь: I enjoy analysing data and presenting the results in charts that are easy to understand.

Тавиур дээрх ургамлыг сонгоход React сон: Selecting a plant on the shelf updates the selection in React. A Motion transition reveals its care instructions and price.
Сагсанд ургамлын ID болон тоо ширхэг хад: The cart stores plant IDs and quantities. When a quantity changes, StoreProvider updates the cart and its total.
place_order функц бүтээгдэхүүний үнийг б: The place_order function reads prices from the database, checks stock and records the order. The server calculates the total.
Тэнхимийн түүхэн баримт болон арга хэмжэ: Department milestones and events use different formats. Time Machine brings them together as entries with a year, title and description.
Зочин түүх эсвэл арга хэмжээний шүүлтүүр: When a visitor selects milestones or events, filter() keeps the matching entries and sort() arranges them by year.
Арга хэмжээний ID-гаар дэлгэрэнгүй хууда: Each event has a detail page identified by its ID. The event_id field links each photo to its event.

Дээд болон доод цэс байрандаа үлдэж, бүт: The top and bottom menus stay in place while the products scroll. Further down, you’ll find today’s pick and recently viewed coffees.

Hero хэсэгт машины гэрэл зургийг CSS bac: The hero uses a car photo as its CSS background, with a Test drive heading and button on top. Each part of the page has its own HTML section.
